bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_CONTAINER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 61; }
name="$names"
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); console.log("STK04_DOCKER_ENV_DB="+(process.env.DATABASE_URL?"YES":"NO"));console.log("STK04_DOCKER_ENV_BOT="+(process.env.BOT_TOKEN?"YES":process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE?"FILE":"NO"));console.log("STK04_DOCKER_WD="+process.cwd());console.log("STK04_NODE_MODULES="+(fs.existsSync("/app/node_modules")?"YES":"NO"));console.log("STK04_STICKER_BUNDLE="+(fs.existsSync("/app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs")?"YES":"NO"));console.log("STK04_GAYBBS_BUNDLE="+(fs.existsSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs")?"YES":"NO"));console.log("STK04_PG_MODULE="+(()=>{try{require.resolve("pg");return "YES"}catch{return "NO"}})());'
echo STK04_DIAG_EXIT_OK
